items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27

ctx.x: Okay, yeah, the streetcar coming up.

Yeah, the Claiborne's right in the middle of the neutral ground, you see. So when he'd get there, when he would get to Louisiana Avenue in Claiborne, the next stop he would say, General Taylor, you know, next stop General Taylor. And right to your left you see the fabulous hurricane. And he would call, just like a train, call up here, call up on a train, right. And of course we got the business, we had more business than we could take here. We couldn't, we couldn't hold the train. The only thing about it, we'd…
So when did you really decide to get into this booking? In the booking?
